page: Google Cloud Platform c3d-standard-8-lssd is a general-purpose cloud instance built on x86_64 architecture featuring the AMD EPYC 9B14 processor. It is configured with 8 vCPUs backed by 4 physical CPU cores operating with 2 threads per core under dedicated allocation. System memory totals 32.0 GB, yielding 4.0 GB of RAM per vCPU. Hardware features include AVX-512 instruction extensions (including vector neural network and bfloat16 instructions), cryptographic acceleration via AES and SHA-NI, and 32 MB of L3 cache. Local storage is provided via a bundled 402 GB local NVMe SSD, while discrete GPU hardware and complimentary public IPv4 addresses are not included.

Benchmark analysis highlights strong single-threaded CPU capability, with stress-ng single-core performance scoring in the top 25% at 2863.28 and Geekbench text processing achieving 2458.0. Multi-core operations align with middle-tier expectations, recorded by stress-ng multi-core at 11475.63, Geekbench multi-core at 6895.0, and PassMark CPU score at 13514.15. Memory performance displays a key distinction: cached small-block memory reads operate at an average 565.78 GB/sec, whereas uncached large-block 256MB reads (36.05 GB/sec) and writes (13.63 GB/sec) fall into the bottom 25% and bottom 10% benchmark tiers, respectively.

The 1:4 vCPU-to-memory balance combined with low-latency local NVMe storage delivers qualitative efficiency for storage-bound and compute-balanced workloads. The instance fits direct-attached database services, static web serving, software build tasks, and Redis caching. Heavy streaming workloads requiring sustained uncached memory throughput represent a primary hardware tradeoff.
description: Google Cloud Platform c3d-standard-8-lssd is a general-purpose virtual machine powered by an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9B14 processor. Configured with 8 dedicated vCPUs across 4 physical cores and 32.0 GB of RAM, it maintains a standard 1:4 compute-to-memory ratio. Hardware capabilities include AVX-512 vector instructions and cryptographic acceleration, paired with a bundled 402 GB local NVMe SSD for direct storage access. Benchmark testing shows top 25% single-core CPU and text processing performance. Multi-core compute, PassMark scores, Redis throughput, and web serving fall into average benchmark tiers. Uncached memory bandwidth represents a primary tradeoff, with large-block write throughput falling into bottom tiers. The c3d-standard-8-lssd instance provides balanced compute and NVMe storage capacity tailored for web applications, database nodes, build compilation, and local caching workloads.
